3.5 Except in a case of urgency, if there is reason to believe a search might have an adverse
effect on relations between the police and the community, the officer in charge shall
consult the local police/community liaison officer:
• before the search; or
• in urgent cases, as soon as practicable after the search.

Codes of practice - Code B Searching premises and seizing property
9
(b) Making an application

3.6 A search warrant application must be supported in writing, specifying:
(a) the enactment under which the application is made (see Note 2A);
(b) (i) whether the warrant is to authorise entry and search of:
• one set of premises; or
• if the application is under PACE section 8, or Schedule 1, paragraph 12,
NSA 2023 Schedule 2, paragraphs 2 or 9; or TACT 2000 Schedule 5
paragraphs 1 or 11, more than one set of specified premises or all
premises occupied or controlled by a specified person, and
(ii) the premises to be searched;
(c) the object of the search (see Note 3B);
(d) the grounds for the application, including, when the purpose of the proposed search
is to find evidence of an alleged offence, an indication of how the evidence relates to
the investigation;
